blockingPage.intro: Stop a website, an internet address or a guest from using your guest WiFi.
blockingPage.onlyAllowedPrefix: To let in only people you have listed, use

firewallPage.appliedCounts: Applied. {{added}} rule(s) put on the router, {{removed}} taken off, {{unchanged}} already there.
firewallPage.appliedNoChange: The router already had exactly these rules. Nothing needed to change.
firewallPage.applyEffect: It takes effect straight away: traffic that matches a Block rule stops, including for guests already connected. Nothing else on the router is changed.
firewallPage.applyNone: No rule is switched on, so the router will be left with none of your rules.
firewallPage.applyOff: {{off}} switched-off rule(s), and any rule you deleted, will be taken off the router.
firewallPage.applyOn: The router will get the {{on}} switched-on rule(s) listed here, checked in the order shown ({{blocks}} of them Block).
firewallPage.applyUnpushable: {{count}} switched-on rule(s) protect the router itself and can't be applied from here, so the router will refuse this change until they are switched off.
firewallPage.bandMissing: This router hasn't been prepared for firewall rules yet. Our team needs to set it up once — contact support.
firewallPage.bandReady: This router is ready for firewall rules.
firewallPage.deleteActive: This rule is on the router now. Deleting it here removes it from this list; it comes off the router the next time you apply.
firewallPage.deletePending: This rule is not on the router, so deleting it changes nothing there.
firewallPage.demoBody: Firewall rules are written to a real router, and the demo account has none.
firewallPage.demoTitle: Not part of the demo account
firewallPage.formHint: Saving doesn't change the router. Apply to router sends your rules to it.
firewallPage.intro: Decide which devices on your network may reach which addresses. Rules are checked in order, top first, and nothing changes on your router until you apply them.
firewallPage.namePlaceholder: e.g. Keep guests off the office printer
firewallPage.noRouterBody: This venue has no router yet.
firewallPage.noRouterTitle: No router here can take firewall rules
firewallPage.noRules: No rules yet. Without any, the router lets your network's traffic through as it does today.
firewallPage.notAppliedHint: {{count}} rule(s) are saved but not on the router. They take effect when you apply them.
firewallPage.savedToast: Saved. Apply to router when you're ready.
firewallPage.whoSpecific: A specific device or group of devices

webFilteringPage.intro: Block whole kinds of website on your guest WiFi, such as adult sites or gambling. Cloudflare keeps the list of which website belongs to which kind.
webFilteringPage.demoTitle: Not part of the demo account
webFilteringPage.demoBody: Web filtering changes a real router, and the demo account has none.
webFilteringPage.categoriesError: Couldn't load the list of categories.
webFilteringPage.notSetUpBody: Once it is, this is where you'll choose the kinds of website to block at this venue.
webFilteringPage.listTitle: What to block at this venue

source.location: This venue uses its own list.
source.organization: This venue uses your account's default list.
source.none: Nothing is chosen for this venue yet, and your account has no default list.

webFilteringPage.noDefault: Your account has no default list.
webFilteringPage.defaultEmpty: Your account's default list blocks nothing.
webFilteringPage.overrides: This venue's own list is used here instead of the account default.
webFilteringPage.ownListNote: Saving gives this venue its own list. Later changes to your account's default won't apply here.
webFilteringPage.appliesNote: Where web filtering is already on at a router here, saving changes what it blocks.
webFilteringPage.notBlockable: Cloudflare doesn't allow blocking this one.
webFilteringPage.noRouterTitle: No router here can use web filtering
webFilteringPage.noRouterBody: This venue has no router yet.
webFilteringPage.statusError: Couldn't read this router's web filtering status.
webFilteringPage.needsCategories: Choose at least one category above and save before turning this on.
webFilteringPage.bypassTitle: Stop guests getting around the filter
webFilteringPage.bypassBody: Stops signed-in guests' devices using their own private lookup service instead of the filter. It can't catch every workaround, and a few apps that insist on their own may not load.
webFilteringPage.bypassNeedsOn: Available once web filtering is on.
webFilteringPage.bypassFailed: The last change to this didn't work.
webFilteringPage.enableWhat: This changes how {{router}} looks up every website, for everyone on its network — guests and your own devices.
webFilteringPage.enableSafety: Straight after the change we check that websites still open. If that check fails, the router switches back to its own settings automatically.
webFilteringPage.disableWhat: The router goes back to the website lookup settings it had before, and the categories on your list stop being blocked.

err.notSetUp: Not set up yet for this account — contact support.
err.tooOld: This router's software is too old for web filtering, so nothing was changed. Contact support to update it.
err.noBootstrap: This router has no website lookup settings of its own for us to start from, so nothing was changed. Contact support.
err.trustUnknown: We couldn't read one of this router's security settings, so nothing was changed. Contact support.
err.changedElsewhere: This router's website lookup settings were changed outside Wyfy Guest, so we left them as they are. Contact support.
err.bypassAnchor: This router is missing the basic protection rules this option builds on, so nothing was changed. Contact support.
err.rolledBack: The check after switching failed, so the router was switched back to its own settings. Guests can browse as before.
err.notRolledBack: The check after switching failed and we could not confirm the router switched back. Guests may not be able to open websites — contact support now.
err.ceiling: Web filtering can't be switched on for another router right now. Contact support.
